examples.english: He's not just an ordinary student — he also runs a company.

notes:
{只|ただ} has multiple meanings depending on context.

AS "FREE":
- {只|ただ}で (for free)
- {只|ただ}でもらう (get for free)

AS "MERELY/ONLY":
- {只|ただ}〜だけ (just ~, only ~)
- {只|ただ}の (mere, ordinary)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {只|ただ}より{高|たか}い{物|もの}はない (There's no such thing as a free lunch)
- {只|ただ}では{済|す}まない (won't get away with it easily)

WRITING NOTE:
- Often written in hiragana: ただ
- Kanji {只|ただ} or {唯|ただ} less common
